cards.back: Answer what you SHOULD do professionally, not what you personally WOULD do. The test assesses professional judgement, not personal opinion.

1. Patient safety (always top)
2. Patient dignity and consent
3. Honesty and integrity
4. Working within competence
5. Knowing when to escalate
6. Supporting colleagues

Very appropriate — ideal response, best practice
Appropriate — acceptable, though not optimal
Inappropriate — not recommended, potential harm
Very inappropriate — dangerous or unethical

Confidentiality CAN be broken when:
- Risk of serious harm to self or others
- Court order or legal requirement
- Child or vulnerable adult protection
- Notifiable infectious diseases
69 questions in 27 minutes ≈ 23 seconds per question. Fastest section — don't overthink. Your first instinct is usually correct.

• Colleague impairment → patient safety first
• Incomplete information → communicate gaps clearly
• Patient requests secrecy → assess risk
• Unprofessional behaviour → address directly but respectfully
• Language barriers → arrange interpreter ASAP
